name: Larry Williamson
occupation: Highway construction (laborer, operator, quality control, and plant manager, since 1998)
background: Larry Williamson ran as the Constitution Party nominee for House District 53 in 2022 and lost the Nov. 8, 2022 general election. His Secretary of State general-election filing listed a Gillette mailing address.

In an Oct. 19, 2022 County 17 candidate questionnaire, Williamson said he was 43 years old, had worked in highway construction since 1998 as a laborer, operator, in quality control, and as a plant manager, and that his education consisted of job-specific certifications and life experience. He wrote that he was originally from Georgia.
